description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the TH02 temperature and humidity sensor, including functions for reading sensor data via I2C, initialization, and data fetching.

methods.name: read8
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the sensor is ready for data reading based on status register.

methods.name: get_humi
methods.description: Triggers humidity measurement and retrieves humidity data.

methods.name: get_temp
methods.description: Triggers temperature measurement and retrieves temperature data.

methods.name: th02_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches temperature and humidity samples from the sensor.

methods.name: th02_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data into sensor_value format for temperature or humidity.

methods.name: th02_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checking if I2C bus is ready.
